note: The estates and communities whose opinion of the crown laws move. Opinion runs 0 to 100 and starts at 50.

nobles.name: Nobles
nobles.about: The lords and their households. Their mood feeds the crown's Authority.

burghers.name: Burghers
burghers.about: Merchants, guildsmen and townsfolk. They keep the towns calm and the tolls flowing.

peasants.name: Peasants
peasants.about: The villages that grow the realm's bread.

eternal_fire.name: Clergy of the Eternal Fire
eternal_fire.about: Zealous, urban, wary of magic and non-humans.

melitele.name: Priestesses of Melitele
melitele.about: Healers and almoners, loved by the poor.

old_ways.name: Keepers of the Old Ways
old_ways.about: Druids and wise women of the countryside, strongest in Velen.

elf.name: Elves
elf.about: Few, watchful, and quick to sympathise with the Scoia'tael.

effects.note: How opinion turns into consequences. Points are opinion away from 50.
